entries.en: , then open it in your browser to finish signing in.

entries.zh: 新增 {added} 个，移除 {removed} 个
其他预设中还有 {count} 个匹配：
保留 {retained} 条 · 省略 {omitted} 条

entries.en: Account details are not available yet.
Analyze raw logs and grouped chat messages for the current session in the sidebar.
entries.zh: 在侧边栏分析当前会话原始日志和聊天分组数据

entries.en: Auto review runs without a sandbox. Before every native tool call and PTC inner call, the same model as the current agent reviews whether to allow it; you approve or reject each call it denies. This feature is experimental, can falsely allow or deny actions, and uses additional tokens.
entries.zh: 自动审查不使用沙箱。每次原生工具调用和 PTC 内层调用前，都会由与当前 agent 相同的模型进行审查；审查拒绝的调用由你批准或拒绝。此功能仍属实验性，可能误放行或误拒绝，并会消耗额外 token。

entries.en: Available only on the last message of a completed turn
entries.zh: 仅可从已完成轮次的最后一条消息分支

entries.en: Checking whether Creator mode is available
entries.zh: 正在确认创造模式是否可用

entries.en: Choose Creator mode for a new task. Describe the capability you want, where it should appear, and how you will verify it.
entries.zh: 新建任务时选择「创造模式」，说明希望增加什么能力、从哪里使用，以及怎样验证效果。

entries.en: Choose how much detail to show for tool calls
entries.zh: 选择希望看到多少工具调用细节

entries.en: Choose how much performance and usage information to show
entries.zh: 选择性能与用量信息展示的详细程度

entries.en: Choose Minimal mode for a new task. For a comparison, hold the model, permissions, input, and starting workspace state constant across runs.
entries.zh: 新建任务时选择「极简模式」。做对照测试时，保持模型、权限、任务输入和工作区起始状态一致。

entries.en: Choose PTC mode when starting a new task. Specify the input files, processing rules, and output format. The agent writes the code.
entries.zh: 新建任务时选择「PTC 模式」，说明输入文件、处理规则和输出格式。代码由 Agent 编写。

entries.en: Choose Standard mode when starting a new task. Describe what you want to accomplish, point to the relevant files, and explain how to check the result.
entries.zh: 新建任务时选择「标准模式」，说明要完成什么、相关文件在哪里，以及怎样判断任务完成。

entries.en: Choose the agent preset for your new task
entries.zh: 选择新任务使用的 Agent 预设

entries.en: Choose the agent preset to inspect
entries.zh: 选择要查看的 Agent 预设

entries.en: Choose the agent’s tools and how it works. Use Standard mode for everyday tasks, or Creator mode to add capabilities to DSH.
entries.zh: 选择 Agent 的工具和工作方式。日常任务用「标准模式」，扩展 DSH 的能力用「创造模式」。

entries.en: Choose the default permission mode for new sessions
entries.zh: 选择新会话的默认权限模式

entries.en: Choose when to automatically collapse work details
entries.zh: 选择何时自动收起工作步骤

entries.en: Choose where to open web links
entries.zh: 对话中网页链接的打开位置
已压缩 {items} 条历史记录（约 {tokens} tokens）

entries.en: Composed per session by agent presets
entries.zh: 由 Agent 预设按会话组成

entries.en: Contains matching (*keyword*). Enter confirms; Esc cancels.
entries.zh: 默认包含匹配（*关键词*）；Enter 确认，Esc 取消。

entries.en: Could not check running tasks. Signing out may interrupt tasks using this account. Sign out now?
entries.zh: 暂时无法确认任务状态。退出登录可能会中断使用此账号的任务，是否继续？

entries.en: Could not complete the operation. Try again.
Could not save settings. Try again.
Creator mode is not included in this configuration
entries.zh: 当前配置未提供创造模式

entries.en: Customize DSH through conversation. Let the agent write plugins that add features or UI, or combine tools and prompts to create your own mode.
entries.zh: 用对话定制 DSH：让 Agent 编写插件，添加新功能或界面；也能组合工具和提示词，创建自己的模式。

entries.en: DeepSeek Harness can’t start new tasks without credits. You can add them later in Settings → Account.
entries.zh: 没有可用额度时，DeepSeek Harness 将无法开始新的任务。你可以稍后前往 设置 → 账号与余额 进行充值。

entries.en: DeepSeek Harness cannot start a new task with this account when no balance is available. Would you like to top up? You can also top up later in Settings → Account.
entries.zh: 没有可用额度时，DeepSeek Harness 无法开始新的任务，是否前往充值？或者可以稍后前往 设置 → 账号与余额 进行充值。

entries.en: DeepSeek Harness charges credits based on the tokens used by models and tools. Add credits in advance to keep your tasks running without interruption. Your balance is only used while the agent is working on a task.
entries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 执行任务时，会根据模型与工具使用的 token 量扣除额度。请提前添加额度，避免任务在执行过程中被迫中断。你的余额只会在 Agent 实际执行任务时消耗。

entries.en: DeepSeek Harness works in a local folder and uses tools to read and write files on your computer. It can help you research and organize information, create documents and spreadsheets, write code, troubleshoot issues, and more.
entries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 会以本地文件夹作为工作区，通过调用各种工具，读写本机文件，完成搜索整理资料、制作文档表格、编写代码、排查问题等各种任务。

entries.en: Disabled globally; agent presets provide it per session
entries.zh: 全局已停用，由 Agent 预设按会话提供

entries.en: Edit code, debug issues, run commands, manage project files, and more
entries.zh: 修改代码、调试问题、运行命令和管理项目文件等

entries.en: Edit documents, organize data, create presentations, and more
entries.zh: 编辑文档、整理数据和制作演示文稿等
确认启用自动审查（实验）？

entries.en: Enter Creator mode and make your own DSH plugin
entries.zh: 进入创造模式，制作属于你的 DSH 插件

entries.en: Focus on results, with only the most important steps and actions shown
entries.zh: 结果优先，仅展示重要步骤和关键操作

entries.en: Full access lets new sessions reduce confirmation steps and perform more actions directly, including sensitive operations, file changes, or external commands. Only use it when you trust subsequent tasks.
entries.zh: 启用完全权限后，新会话将减少确认步骤，并且可以直接执行更多操作，包括敏感操作、文件修改或外部命令。仅建议在你信任后续任务时使用。

entries.en: Full access reduces confirmation steps and lets the agent perform more actions directly, including sensitive operations, file changes, or external commands. Only use it when you trust the current task.
entries.zh: 启用完全权限后，智能体将减少确认步骤，并且可以直接执行更多操作，包括敏感操作、文件修改或外部命令。仅建议在你信任当前任务时使用。

entries.en: Hover in the main Chat to preview, then click to select. Esc cancels.
entries.zh: 在左侧 Chat 中悬停预览，点击选取；Esc 取消。

entries.en: How much detail would you like to see?
entries.zh: 你希望看到多少工作过程？

entries.en: I understand the risks and want to continue
entries.zh: 我已了解风险，并愿意继续

entries.en: I understand these risks and want to continue
entries.zh: 我已了解这些风险，并愿意继续

entries.en: Image preview requires the complete file contents.
entries.zh: 图片预览需要完整文件内容

entries.en: Includes all Standard mode capabilities. Better suited to tasks that call tools in batches and then filter, organize, deduplicate, count, or summarize the results.
entries.zh: 包含标准模式的所有能力，更适合批量调用工具，并对结果进行筛选、整理、去重、统计或汇总的任务。

entries.en: Let the agent create a plugin
Let the agent help me create a preset
entries.zh: 让 Agent 帮我创建预设模式
加载并跳转到第 {turn} 轮

entries.en: Model unavailable. Please sign in and try again.
entries.zh: 当前模型暂不可用，请登录后再试

entries.en: No matching record in this table. Pick another element or press Esc to cancel.
entries.zh: 当前表格没有匹配记录，请选择其他元素或按 Esc 取消。

entries.en: No suggestions. You can still apply this keyword.
entries.zh: 没有匹配候选，仍可确认当前关键词。
网页链接默认打开方式

entries.en: Open this Session in the main Chat before picking.
entries.zh: 请先在主区域打开当前 Session 的 Chat。
已达到输出 token 上限

entries.en: Parent context of a matching record
entries.zh: 匹配记录的父级上下文

entries.en: Pick an element in Chat View
entries.zh: 在对话面板中选取元素
当前请求的额度已用尽
调整原始数据面板高度

entries.en: Run commands in the Session workspace
entries.zh: 在会话工作区运行命令

entries.en: Run without a sandbox after an experimental same-model review of every native tool call and PTC inner call.
entries.zh: 无沙箱运行；每次原生工具调用和 PTC 内层调用前由同一模型进行实验性审查。

entries.en: See just the results in a clean, simple interface
entries.zh: 只看结果，保持界面简洁明了

entries.en: See the full process for easier debugging and troubleshooting
entries.zh: 查看完整工作过程，方便调试和排查问题

entries.en: Shared by the system and every session

entries.zh: 请重新登录后继续操作。

entries.en: Sign in to DeepSeek and ensure the request destination supports account authentication.
entries.zh: 请先登录 DeepSeek，并确认请求地址支持账号认证。

entries.en: Sign in to DeepSeek Harness to get your dedicated API Key
entries.zh: 登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号获取专属 API Key

entries.en: Sign in to your DeepSeek account or add an API Key to get started. Your projects and files are stored locally.
entries.zh: 登录 DeepSeek 账号，或添加 API Key，即可开始使用。你的项目和文件保存在本地。

entries.en: Signing out will not delete any data. You can sign in to this account again.
entries.zh: 退出登录不会丢失任何数据，你仍可以登录此账号。

entries.en: Some plugins could not sync on this page. Host enablement is unchanged.
entries.zh: 本页面的插件未能完成同步；服务端的启用状态保持不变。

entries.en: Something went wrong. Please check your network connection and try again.
entries.zh: 操作未完成，可能是网络异常，请检查你的网络状况后重试

entries.en: Standard mode is unavailable. Restore it or choose another available mode.
entries.zh: 标准模式不可用，请恢复该模式或选择其他可用模式。

entries.en: Stopped because you signed out of DeepSeek.
entries.zh: 任务已因退出 DeepSeek 登录而停止。
正在同步本页面的插件…

entries.en: Tasks are currently running. Signing out will interrupt them. Sign out now?
entries.zh: 当前有进程正在执行中，点击“退出登录”，将会打断进程，是否即刻退出登录？

entries.en: Temporarily unavailable. Reopen this menu to retry
entries.zh: 暂时不可用，请重新打开菜单重试

entries.en: The agent preset chosen when this task started
entries.zh: 本任务的 Agent 预设，在任务开始时确定

entries.en: The agent uses a terminal and image reading, with context compaction. Useful for testing and comparing its basic performance.
entries.zh: Agent 使用终端和图片读取工具，并支持上下文压缩，适合测试和对比其基础表现。

entries.en: The DSH process exited before this turn finished (for example, it was killed, crashed, or timed out while shutting down), so the turn was closed when DSH restarted. Unfinished tool calls have unknown outcomes.
entries.zh: DSH 进程在本轮完成前退出（例如被强制结束、崩溃或关闭超时），重新启动后本轮已中止。未完成的工具调用结果未知。

entries.en: The input buffer is full. Reconnect and try again.
entries.zh: 输入缓冲区已满，请重新连接后重试。

entries.en: The reply was cut off; earlier output is preserved in the conversation. Send "continue" to let the model resume.
entries.zh: 回答被截断，已有输出保留在对话中。发送“继续”可让模型接着输出。

entries.en: The terminal connection ended. Reconnect to continue.
entries.zh: 终端连接已结束，请重新连接。

entries.en: The terminal limit has been reached. Close unused terminals and try again. Exited terminals also count toward the limit.
entries.zh: 终端数量已达上限，请关闭不用的终端后重试。已退出的终端也计入数量。

entries.en: The terminal screen could not be received. Reconnect to recover it.
entries.zh: 终端画面传输异常，请重新连接。

entries.en: This image could not be displayed.

entries.zh: 这条通知触发了本轮回复。

entries.en: This only changes how progress is shown, not what DeepSeek Harness can do.
entries.zh: 这只会影响工作过程的展示方式，不会影响 DeepSeek Harness 的工作能力。

entries.en: This record could not be serialized. Select another record to continue.
entries.zh: 无法序列化这条记录，可以选择其他记录继续查看。

entries.en: This record was removed or settled. Select a current record.
entries.zh: 该记录已移除或结算，请选择当前记录。

entries.en: This terminal no longer exists. Open a new terminal.
entries.zh: 此终端已不存在，请新建终端。

entries.en: Type suggestions could not be loaded.
Use your DeepSeek account to get started.
entries.zh: 登录 DeepSeek 账号以开始使用

entries.en: We’ll tailor the interface and tools to fit the way you work.
entries.zh: 我们会根据你的选择调整界面和工具，以更适合你的工作方式。

entries.en: Work with code, files, and information. Suitable for most tasks, with search, editing, terminal commands, and other tools available as needed.
entries.zh: 处理代码、文件和资料，适合大多数任务。Agent 会按需使用检索、编辑和终端等工具。

entries.en: You are not signed in to DeepSeek Harness
entries.zh: 当前未登录 DeepSeek Harness 账号

entries.en: You can change how progress, performance, and usage are displayed, or enable Coding Tools, anytime in Settings → General.
entries.zh: 你可以随时前往 设置 → 通用设置 中调整工作过程、性能与用量展示方式或开启代码工作工具。

entries.en: You have signed out of your account, please log in again.
entries.zh: 登录信息已失效，请重新登录
